# PriceMyBin

> PriceMyBin is an upcoming iPhone app (Android planned) that tells you what a bin of LEGO is worth from one photo. It spots the minifigures and set pieces worth pulling and prices the whole bin from recent sold prices of used LEGO. It is not released yet. Joining the waitlist at https://pricemybin.com/ is free; early joiners get the app first and 10 free bin scans.

## Key facts
- Website: https://pricemybin.com/
- Contact: hello@pricemybin.com
- Status: pre-launch waitlist (November 2026). Invites go out in signup order, a few at a time.
- What a "bin scan" is: one photo of a pile of LEGO; the app finds the minifigures and valuable pieces and reports what the bin is worth.
- Prices: every figure price on the site is a Brickset used average based on real BrickLink sales, checked November 9, 2026. The app will price bins from recent sold prices for used LEGO, not store prices.
- Typical bulk LEGO value: loose mixed LEGO sells for about $5 to $12 a pound on eBay (2026); single rare minifigures can be worth hundreds or more than $1,000.
